goal:
Week 6 Dev B, one session, one branch: feat/week6-dev-b-story-town-art off main (after PR 4 merges; otherwise off feat/run-economy-W5-dev-b-town-screens). Read CLAUDE.md, specs/SPEC-story-dialogue.md, specs/SPEC-town.md, specs/SPEC-run-economy.md, specs/SPEC-art-audio.md and the W6-B1 to W6-B6 lines in tasks/todo.md first.

Work in this order and commit after each step, so the diff stays reviewable:

1. W6-B1 story-dialogue: StoryManager (namespaced flags, flags.json declaration, act(), evaluate() condition language, unlock_lore) and the DialogueData loader from JSON with schema validation. Pure logic first, host-authoritative, with GUT tests for every condition-language case and every schema rejection.
2. W6-B2 story-dialogue: DialogueBox UI (portrait, name, typewriter, choices, per-player in town), start_dialogue, LorePage pickup plus LORE populator, codex list stub. Use the ui-sign-off skill: mock it up and wait for my yes before writing the real UI.
3. W6-B3 story-dialogue: Act 1 content as JSON only (early NPC lines, forum topics, boss-defeated reactions) with the story flags and progression hooks it needs. Content is data, not new systems.
4. W6-B5 run-economy: polish the Shop and Rest room interactables and add currency scaling by biome. Pure rules in a static class with tests, thin nodes on top. Wire PotionController.use() to the potion action only if it can be done without editing Dev A's player scene; otherwise leave it and say so.
5. W6-B4 town: NPC nodes that call start_dialogue (now possible after step 2), the Alchemist menu (slots, heal potion), the Map Room next-floor modifier preview, and building level sprites for four states.
6. W6-B6 art, through the Python generators under tools/art/ with palette names only and a review sheet in docs/asset-review/week-6/: 8 NPC walk and idle sheets, 8 portraits (Hilde, Gruff, Moss, Pip, Sister Ash, Old Tom, Vesper, rescued miner v1), the DialogueBox theme (portrait frame, name plate, choice buttons), lore page UI, codex list theme, and the Alchemist and Map Room level 1 building states. Register new generators in build_all.py and keep build_all.py --check clean. Stop at the review sheet and wait for my approval before marking it approved in docs/asset-review/INDEX.md.

Rules: strict static typing; tests ship with the code; in GUT, use named method callbacks, never lambdas, with .connect. Stop and ask before changing project.godot, Input Map, autoloads, scripts/data/ Resource definitions, Events signals, the save schema, CI or addons, and never edit a .tscn owned by Dev A. Run the full GUT suite, the art pytest suite and the two-instance smoke test before pushing. Never use real names in files, comments, commits or PRs; say Dev A and Dev B. Open one PR into main, end its body with the Claude Code attribution line, then bind it with the ccd_pr tools and turn on Auto-fix. Do not merge it.
